resources.string: Search station and timetable data from RailRadar through the RailReserve backend.
Live search uses RailRadar timetable data. Fare and live seat availability are not enabled in this app. Real ticket booking is not available.
Search by station name or code
Type at least 2 characters to search stations.
Manage locally stored demonstration bookings or explore the demo reservation workflow.
DEMO ONLY - These are local demonstration records, not IRCTC reservations or real railway tickets.
This app has no account or sign-in system. Passenger details exist only in local demo booking records on this device; the app does not maintain a separate profile.

Technology: Java, XML Android Views, SQLite, and the existing Node.js backend.

Live data: station search and scheduled timetable information provided by RailRadar through the RailReserve backend.

Demo features: local sample train search, reservations, PNR lookup, and cancellation.

Limitations: fare information and live seat availability are not enabled in this app. The app does not issue real railway tickets, process payments, or provide live running status.
